country_event = {
	id = 420000105
	title = "tgcx_promise_broken_reactionary_title"
	desc = "tgcx_promise_broken_reactionary_desc"
	picture = "senate_debate"

	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = tgcx_debt_reactionary
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = tgcx_debt_deadline_reactionary }
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = { days = 1 }

	option = {
		name = "tgcx_promise_broken_reactionary_ok"
		clr_country_flag = tgcx_debt_reactionary
		any_pop = { scaled_militancy = { ideology = reactionary factor = 2 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = tgcx_debt_broken_reactionary duration = 3650 }
	}
}
